title: Nearly P500-M shabu shipment from Mexico seized at NAIA
summary: Authorities intercepted 73 kilograms of high-grade shabu worth an estimated P496.413 million that was concealed inside industrial machinery shipped from Guadalajara, Mexico, authorities said.
